scientific_integrity: Theorem proved from unitary dilation, mean ergodicity, and a uniform Fourier-dilution argument. Finite checker is diagnostic, not a proof. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complex Hilbert-space contractions only; base-point syndetic returns, not the uniform orbit-translation recurrence profile; no optimal recurrence-window estimates or extension to general power-bounded Banach operators; classical spectral-priority overlap remains possible.
title: Exact recurrence-radius seminorm for Hilbert-space contractions
